hypothesis: Replacing a conservative fixed 2-pip spread assumption with authentic timestamp-paired observed book spreads may change net profitability; validate, never omit actual costs.
prior_results_examined: All 24 fixed-spread development strategies at $100k and $500k; all negative. No observed-book strategy P&L examined.

data.provider: Dukascopy Bank SA original public historical datafeed
data.schema: timestamp,open,high,low,close,volume are original BID; ask_open/high/low/close/volume are exact timestamp-matched original ASK
data.pairing: left join on original BID UTC bar timestamp; preserve every BID exit bar
data.missing_or_crossed_ask: block new entries with allowed mask; internal BID placeholder only on forbidden-entry bars to satisfy numeric engine, never an executable invented ASK
data.entry_quote_validity: actual ask_open finite, >= actual bid_open; no spread floor, no guessed spread, no parameter-based spread filtering
data.raw_and_paired_sha256: record source paths/hash receipts before each first dataset evaluation
data.reserved_final: UNTOUCHED, never loaded by this module

execution.signal: completed previous bar; exact next actual open
execution.gap_before_entry: reject unless preceding M15 bar contiguous
execution.prior6h_down: close[t] < open[t-23], with 24 contiguous M15 bars
execution.holding_bars: 8,16,24 actual M15 intervals; missing bars may extend clock duration
execution.holding_clock: explicit local-session time exit after 2/4/6h; gaps execute next actual open
execution.sample_end: liquidate, include net P&L, exclude natural-close count
execution.funding: fully owned whole EUR, no leverage, maximum principal .008 equity
execution.worst_loss: entire principal + modeled liquidation costs <= .01 entry equity
execution.entry: actual entry ASK open plus 0.2-pip modeled slippage
execution.exit: actual BID execution reference less 0.2-pip modeled slippage
execution.triggers: original BID OHLC, stop-first; stops/targets anchored to entry BID
execution.price_baseline_reporting: BID gross reference, not midpoint gross

fixed_spread_pips_field: ignored only because actual observed ASK replaces assumed spread; commissions/slippage unchanged

cost_stress.rule: same frozen strategy; multiply actual entry spread, slippage, commission rate and minimum commission; report both splits; no reselection from stress

selection.evaluate: the same 24 preregistered configs on both development and selection-validation; this is a new disclosed source-confirmation round
selection.required_per_split: net wins >=50%, total and natural profit after all costs positive, zero observed 1% adverse/peak-drawdown breaches
selection.rank: largest minimum development/validation net return; validation net return descending; stable candidate name ascending
selection.bootstrap: confidence diagnostic, not an additional user acceptance rule
selection.activation: never enabled by this module; freeze separately before independent final

statistics.series: UTC calendar-day realized equity returns, including inactive days

source_selection_limitation: capital/source sensitivity was motivated by observed earlier development; validation is used for selection and is not an independent final test
